the-opium-habit: Horace B. Day's frank study of the opium habit — its grip, its horrors, and its cure — warned Victorian America. Based on medical knowledge and sad cases, it spoke plainly. A brave early work on addiction. His warnings helped awaken a nation to a growing curse.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-augustine-fra: A 1913 entry on Augustine Hewit — the Paulist founder. Henry Wyman honors his convert's zeal. He built the American congregation. The missions to non-Catholics knew his voice. A pioneer of the American Church. His sermons drew the New York crowds.
